notes.title: Update to Hana's Picks!
notes.notes:
In the previous update Hana can decide one of the most difficult choices for you:
'Which hero/champion should I play this time?'

In addition to new released characters which can be accessed by

pick lol
pick dota
pick smite
pick overwatch

Hana can also decide with

pick paladins

Can you get a winning streak with Hana's Picks?


(Check out "csgo" in the talk-mode.) :hanawoo:

notes.title: Hana helps you to choose a hero/champion!
notes.notes:
You don't know which hero to pick in your games? Just ask Hana!
Type (either in oracle or talk mode):

pick dota
pick lol
pick ow
pick smite

And let Hana decide your pick/ban choice! ːhana1ːːhana2ː

Your Friend Hana is also on sale for 14 days starting on 31st March!

P.S. 17th April is Hana's birthday!

notes.title: Words requesting is now open!!
notes.notes:
Do you want to get your own exclusive word included in the game?
Just ask Hana! ːhana1ːːhana2ː
Request it by writing an e-mail to justaskhana@hotmail.com or write on the official reddit site: https://www.reddit.com/r/JustAskHana/

ːHanaBombː Follow Hana on twitter: https://twitter.com/JustAskHana

Please check if the word does not already exist and you can request it!
Some words are randomly picked and Hana will say a few words about it or make a game out of it!
In addition to "normal" words, you can also request special words, like your nickname or clan name to advertise! If you request something like that, please explain what the "special word" is about, else Hana won't know!

If you want to have your Hana related arts featured in the game, please post your artworks on the reddit site. E-mails with attachments are automatically discarded.

Have you found a mistake? Please report the bug/mistake to the e-mail address "justaskhana@hotmail.com". ːhanawooː
